criterion: A range is 'observed' when SIFMA_US agrees, on every weekday in it, with the New York Fed's SOFR publication record: a business day exactly where SOFR was published. The record is FRED series SOFR, downloaded on 2026-10-15 for 2018-04-03 to 2026-10-14, and is pasted as a list of dates in tests/test_sifma_publication_record.py, which holds the calendar to it and ties SIFMA_US.VERIFIED_FROM and VERIFIED_THROUGH to its ends. Anything after the record is the rules extrapolated, so 'assumed'.
note: Generated FROM rates_engine.conventions.calendar, so on its own it cannot catch a wrong rule; the independent check is the publication record named in 'criterion'. That check is PRD-001 AC-1.2's [manual-check], done against the record rather than against sifma.org, which this environment cannot reach. It found three wrong rules in v0.3, all fixed in v0.4: Memorial Day a week early when the last Monday of May is the 29th to 31st; New Year's Day and Veterans Day on a Saturday moved to the Friday, which SIFMA does not do; and no closure on 2018-12-05. Rules the record has not yet exercised: Juneteenth on a Saturday (first 2027-06-19).
